clauses.text: A route deviation is measured as the percentage by which the actual distance travelled exceeds the optimal (shortest/expected) route distance.
Deviation below 5% is considered within normal navigation tolerance and no refund is issued.
Deviation between 5% and 15% without a valid traffic or safety reason entitles the rider to a refund of the excess distance fare.
Deviation of 15% or more, or any deviation accompanied by an unexplained stop, entitles the rider to a refund of the excess distance fare plus 50% of the base fare.
A valid traffic detour (confirmed by live traffic data) reduces the assessed deviation severity and may void the refund if the detour is reasonable.
Surge pricing applied to the disputed excess distance shall be refunded proportionally.
Excess TIME fare attributable to a route deviation is not separately refunded; only the excess distance fare (and its proportional surge) is refunded under RD-001.3 or RD-001.4.
A no-show cancellation fee may only be charged when the driver has arrived within 150 metres of the pickup point and waited at least 5 minutes.
If the driver never arrived within 150 metres of the pickup point, the cancellation fee must be fully refunded.
If the driver arrived more than 10 minutes late, the cancellation fee is waived regardless of rider no-show.
If the driver arrived on time but waited less than 5 minutes before cancelling, the cancellation fee must be refunded.
If the driver arrived on time and waited at least 5 minutes with documented contact attempts, the no-show fee is upheld against the rider.
A first-time rider no-show dispute may receive a one-time courtesy credit at the reviewer's discretion.
A cleaning fee may be charged only when supported by photo evidence that matches the trip timestamp and is not AI-generated.
Standard mess cleaning fee is SGD 25; severe soiling or damage is SGD 50 to SGD 150 subject to review.
Safety incidents are high priority, are routed for fast-track review, and may result in immediate account suspension pending investigation.
Any report of threats, violence, or inappropriate behaviour is escalated to a human reviewer regardless of model confidence.
Accounts with repeated dispute filings may be flagged for bad-faith behaviour and their claims subjected to higher scrutiny.
Evidence of collusion or fabricated claims voids the dispute and may result in account restrictions.
